title: Zesty Dense Spanish Apricot Fideua
description: A dense and energizing Spanish dish featuring apricot, with a herbal twist and a low glycemic index, made in the traditional fideua form with a lamination puff pastry crust.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut the pastry into a rectangle about 12 inches by 18 inches.
Spread the apricot jam evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border on either side.
Arrange the fideua pasta on top of the jam, leaving a small border around the edges.
Drizzle the olive oil over the pasta and sprinkle with minced garlic and chopped rosemary.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Fold the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with a little water and sprinkle with grated manchego cheese if using.
Place the fideua on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
